items.title: BD’s (NYSE:BDX) Q3 CY2026: beats on revenue, but full year guidance comes in just below expectations
items.summary: Medical technology company Becton, Dickinson and Company (NYSE:BDX) reported calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q4 2026) results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with revenue up 5.4% year on year to $5.27 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.15 per share was 2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
